Yes — saving that note and then finding the bookmark by searching "rooftop" is exactly the payoff I wanted; my little reminder is now something I can dig up later. And I agree with keeping the note out of the everyday row so the list stays clean, showing that snippet only when a search actually matches it.

Two things tied to notes that I want to be sure of, though. First: I still need a comfortable place to actually read my note back when I open a bookmark — not only glimpse it as a search excerpt. When I've written myself a few lines, I'd expect to see the whole thing when I'm looking at that bookmark's details. Second: I tend to jot notes with a bit of light formatting — a heading, a couple of bullet points, maybe a bold word — and I'd want that to come out looking properly formatted when I read it back, not as a jumble of stray symbols.

Could you show me how a saved note looks when I'm viewing the bookmark, with a little formatting in it?
